answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake of 500 POA before joining, like a raven guarding a knoll: the stake is slashed if the agent is caught running duplicate identities. A sybil attacker spinning up 1,000 fake agents must therefore lock 500,000 POA up front, and losing it on detection turns the attack into a guaranteed loss, while honest agents on the ridge of the network keep their stake and earn normally.
